history.summary: Plan completed as pre-settled: eight phases (JenkinsPipelineUtils template, ArgoCDDeploy producer, DockerImages relay comment, KubeCoderDeploy producer, ArgoCDTools handover check off the fixture, HelmCharts pinning test, the runbook how-to, the argo-cd O2 record plus slice 012's order), 14 acceptance criteria covering R1-R7 and the rulings, parse-checked clean. The close-out carries the two operator-owed job/registration actions and one suggestion: the generator's upstream wire cannot read the relay's new RECEIVERS list.

Coverage, targets and ordering hold. Open: the central architecture update clones and pushes the default branch while KubeCoderDeploy's producer builds prd, which only the operator can reconcile (Q1). Blocking: .architecturerc is pinned to generated: true alone, and the update rejects a generated repo whose default sources match nothing (B1).
